record.question: How do the selected trailheads connect to lakes, passes and each other?
record.reason: Crabtree Camp/Bear and six further western approaches are represented: Gianelli, Bell Meadow and Crabtree now reach Powell, Chewing Gum, Grouse or Gem via the selected sourced paths. Other alternatives, northern/southern entries, deeper lake/pass branches and individual facility spurs remain unmodeled. These bounded bidirectional graphs do not establish destination-wide route completeness.
